question: What practice over what period is enjoined for one who takes up the ochre robe free from bondage?
premises: One who takes up the ochre robe free from bondage is in view.
That person should practice from six months onward.
The practice is enjoined as a duty over that period.
inference: From six months onward, one who has taken up the ochre robe free from bondage should practice.
uncertainties: The object or content of practice is not specified here.
plain_english: Indeed, one who takes up the ochre robe free from bondage should practice from six months onward.
